The deploy didn't succeed. Image `api:7f3c2e1` was built, pushed, and set on `deployment/api` in staging, but `/healthz` returned 503 until the 60s healthcheck timed out.

I don't know the cause yet. The new pods may still be starting, may be failing readiness, or may be crash-looping. It's also unclear whether the old pods are still serving or staging is down. The next checks are `kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n staging` and the logs of the new pods. If staging needs to be up now, `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n staging` reverts to the previous image.
